== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Imperial Domination (Japanese)|Imperial Domination]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/149261356/X4P-FrYsHEa7-ZTwVRdrtg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 83063559.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>a46b8d24fb3fa18b3b2819529b4a372840c73af47b22d0a44bfd5611ee595ff0</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
